pages.preference.lan.title: Friends / LAN
pages.preference.lan.description: Connect up to 8 cats using an IP and room code. Missing models stay in session cache, outside your model list.
pages.preference.lan.noAddress: No preferred public temporary IPv6 address found. Enable IPv6 privacy addresses in your OS/network settings.
pages.preference.lan.privacy: Temporary IPv6 reduces tracking. Model and pose traffic uses Noise encrypted authentication. Use a strong room code and your firewall. IPv6 format: [address]:port. The host decrypts and relays room data; join a trusted host.
pages.preference.lan.invalid: Select a model, enter an IP:port and a room code of 8–64 characters.
pages.preference.lan.friend: Friend’s display name (only on this device)
pages.preference.lan.failed: Connection failed or disconnected. Check the address, room code, firewall and model size.
pages.preference.lan.createHint: Up to 8 people: share your address and room code, then wait for friends.
pages.preference.lan.joinHint: Enter the host address and room code to join a multiplayer room.
